tasks.title: install.sh: add --with-cross-browser flag to install webkit/firefox system deps
definition_of_done: reference-impl/install.sh parses --with-cross-browser from "$@" at the top of the script, before any other argument processing
When --with-cross-browser is present on Linux, `npx playwright install-deps webkit firefox` is invoked, replacing the current unconditional `install-deps webkit`-only call

When --with-cross-browser is absent on Linux, the existing `npx playwright install-deps webkit` behavior is preserved unchanged, and the script prints the informational note: "(Pass --with-cross-browser to also install webkit/firefox system deps for cross-browser UI review.)"

On non-Linux platforms, no additional bash guard is needed inside the flagged branch — playwright's own installer handles non-apt platforms as a graceful no-op (warning + exit 0); the flag does not introduce a new failure mode
README.md documents the --with-cross-browser flag with a note: pass --with-cross-browser when .cloverleaf/config/ui-review.json sets browsers to include webkit or firefox

A shell-mock regression test in reference-impl/tests/ (or reference-impl/scripts/) asserts that `npx playwright install-deps webkit firefox` is invoked when --with-cross-browser is present and that only `npx playwright install-deps webkit` (not install-deps firefox) is invoked when the flag is absent
All changes pass the existing reference-impl test suite (npm test in reference-impl/)
acceptance_criteria: install.sh --with-cross-browser invokes `npx playwright install-deps webkit firefox` on Linux (RFC CLV-40 AC #1, spike CLV-41 recommendation)
install.sh without --with-cross-browser on Linux invokes only `npx playwright install-deps webkit` (not firefox) and prints the informational note (RFC CLV-40 AC #2)
The shell-mock regression test passes: with --with-cross-browser the mock records `install-deps webkit firefox`; without it the mock records only `install-deps webkit` (RFC CLV-40 AC #4)
`grep 'with-cross-browser' reference-impl/install.sh` returns at least one match confirming the flag is parsed
On non-Linux platforms the flagged path does not fail — playwright's graceful no-op is sufficient; no additional bash guard is needed per spike CLV-41 finding #2

tasks.title: Documenter CHANGELOG conflict: dual-flag annotation in plan.md, suppression preflight in documenter.md, --ours fallback in SKILL.md
definition_of_done: reference-impl/prompts/plan.md gains a ~4-line addition instructing the Plan agent to emit extensions["clv.version-bump-custodian"]: true on the custodian task AND extensions["clv.changelog-suppressed"]: true on each non-custodian sibling task at breakdown time

reference-impl/prompts/documenter.md gains a ~6-line preflight block inserted after the cd preflight already added by CLV-46: if task.extensions["clv.changelog-suppressed"] === true, return {"commits_added": 0, "files_changed": [], "summary": "CHANGELOG suppressed: custodian sibling handles version bump and release section."} immediately without touching CHANGELOG.md

reference-impl/prompts/documenter.md's preflight also handles task.extensions["clv.version-bump-custodian"]: when true, the Documenter writes the ## <version> CHANGELOG section as directed by the task's definition_of_done rather than ## [Unreleased]

reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md rebase step uses -X ours (or git checkout --ours) for reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md when a conflict is detected during walker rebase, as a belt-and-suspenders fallback for Documenter versions predating this fix

A regression test in reference-impl/tests/ verifies the Documenter CHANGELOG-skip behavior: given a synthesized task JSON with extensions["clv.changelog-suppressed"]: true, the expected output has commits_added: 0 and no CHANGELOG.md entry in files_changed
The cd preflight already present in reference-impl/prompts/documenter.md from CLV-46 is NOT removed or moved; the CHANGELOG suppression logic is added as a subsequent block
All changes pass the existing reference-impl test suite (npm test in reference-impl/)
acceptance_criteria: `grep 'clv.changelog-suppressed' reference-impl/prompts/plan.md` returns a match confirming the dual-flag emission instruction (RFC CLV-40 AC #5, spike CLV-42 Option B)

The documenter.md preflight block checks task.extensions["clv.changelog-suppressed"] and exits early with {commits_added: 0, files_changed: [], summary: "CHANGELOG suppressed..."} when the flag is true (RFC CLV-40 AC #6)
The documenter.md preflight block writes ## <version> (not ## [Unreleased]) when task.extensions["clv.version-bump-custodian"] is true (RFC CLV-40 AC #7)
`grep 'ours' reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` returns a match confirming the -X ours or --ours directive for CHANGELOG (RFC CLV-40 AC #9)
The regression test passes: a mock task JSON with extensions["clv.changelog-suppressed"]: true produces commits_added: 0 with no CHANGELOG.md in files_changed (RFC CLV-40 AC #8)
reference-impl/prompts/documenter.md still contains the `cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)` preflight line from CLV-46 (must not be removed — regression guard)

tasks.title: Session B CWD drift fix: WORKTREE_ROOT injection in SKILL.md + cd preflight in all five agent prompts
definition_of_done: reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md embeds the absolute $WORKTREE_ROOT path in the Session B scenario brief, with an explicit instruction that Session B's first preflight step must execute `cd "$WORKTREE_ROOT"` before any git command
reference-impl/prompts/implementer.md gains `cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"` as its first executable preflight line

reference-impl/prompts/documenter.md gains `cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"` as its first executable preflight line (downstream task CLV-45 will add CHANGELOG suppression logic after this line — do not preempt or remove it)
reference-impl/prompts/reviewer.md gains `cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"` as its first executable preflight line
reference-impl/prompts/ui-reviewer.md gains `cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"` as its first executable preflight line
reference-impl/prompts/qa.md gains `cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"` as its first executable preflight line
All changes pass the existing reference-impl test suite (npm test in reference-impl/)
acceptance_criteria: `grep 'WORKTREE_ROOT' reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` returns a match confirming the absolute path is injected into the Session B brief and cd instruction is present (RFC CLV-40 AC #10)

`grep 'cd.*git rev-parse.*show-toplevel' reference-impl/prompts/implementer.md reference-impl/prompts/reviewer.md reference-impl/prompts/ui-reviewer.md reference-impl/prompts/qa.md` returns matches in all four files (RFC CLV-40 AC #11)
`grep 'cd.*git rev-parse.*show-toplevel' reference-impl/prompts/documenter.md` returns a match confirming the preflight is present (RFC CLV-40 AC #11)
All five prompts have the cd preflight as the first executable line, not buried mid-file
The existing reference-impl test suite passes unchanged (npm test in reference-impl/)
